sources.title: 2026 Roadmap on Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning for Smart Manufacturing
sources.scope_limit: Roadmap identifies industrial opportunities, data integration and reliability challenges, not a measured worldwide quality improvement.

sources.title: Augmented Intelligence for Manufacturing Systems (AIMS)
sources.scope_limit: Measurement science, physical metrology and machine-specific digital twin goals; current webpage not a dated single experimental report.

sources.title: Advanced Informatics and Artificial Intelligence for Additive Manufacturing
sources.scope_limit: Program research goals for first-part-correct and born-qualified, not proven universal qualification.

sources.title: Digital Twins Workshops Summary Report
sources.scope_limit: Interoperability, verification, validation and uncertainty issues in digital twins.

sources.title: ISO 9001:2026 Quality Management Systems
sources.scope_limit: Quality management system standard; not direct qualification of any manufactured component or AI model.

sources.title: ISO 22514-2:2026 Process Capability and Performance
sources.scope_limit: Time-dependent process capability; assumptions and applicability must be validated for each task.

sources.title: ISO 22514-7:2026 Measurement Process Capability
sources.scope_limit: Measurement system/process can meet task requirements only under stated uncertainties and acceptance criteria.

sources.title: ISO 10218-2:2025 Industrial Robot Applications and Robot Cells
sources.scope_limit: Robot application/cell safety; specific scope exclusions and integration obligations remain.

sources.publisher: IEEE Engineering Management Review / Macquarie University
sources.title: Designing an integrated human–AI quality control framework: a 10-year case study in regulated medical device manufacturing
sources.scope_limit: A bounded measured inspection consistency comparison, not proof of superior manufactured product lifespan or global AI ability.

source_bound_claims.observation_zh: NIST 2026 路線圖討論製造 AI 在監控、機器人、增材製造、孿生等潛力，同時提醒資料、整合與可信運作挑戰。
NIST AIMS 強調現場量測與物理模型和 AI 融合，避免以欠缺校準的模型推論真實機台品質。
ISO 22514-7:2026 提供驗證量測過程能力及接受準則的方法，不直接認證任何 AI 製成零件。
該醫療器材案例報告在特定複雜幾何量測任務中，AI 量測的變異係數較受測人工檢驗者低，約有 4–12 倍一致性差異；不代表品質超越在全部產品維度成立。

direct_measurement.comparator: five experienced human inspectors in specific study

source_bound_claims.observation_zh: 增材製造 first-part-correct／born-qualified 是建立感測、數位線索和物理品質保證的方法目標，不能誤稱為已全面實現。
數位孿生中的驗證、確認、不確定度量化和互通性，仍需與實際製造品質確認分離。

notes: This registry records source assertions and standard scopes, not FSL-measured AI manufacturing outcomes.
Publication dates and source review date are separate.
Month-precision standards dates must not become invented first-day timestamps.
One bounded measuring-consistency result cannot automatically imply higher final physical part quality.
